_comment: The projection's pinned cases, shared by services/edit.py (tests/test_edit.py) and frontend/src/lib/edit.ts (edit.test.ts) so the two copies cannot drift silently. Five sentences over a 12 s recording with 6.0-7.5 removed; the corpus keep in output_durations is the 5 s cut measured on the real 341 s source. The tracks section is E3's: one list per track, the narration projected through the NARRATION list and the picture cut with the VIDEO list - a projection through the wrong list gives the same indices and the wrong starts, which is the trap these cases catch.

tracks._comment: The same five sentences (start, end). The video list removes 6.0-7.5; the narration list removes 6.4-7.0 - both drop the third sentence, but the sentences after it move by 1.5 s under one list and 0.6 s under the other. Each case gives the sentences the plan lists, as [index, start, end] in the output's seconds, the picture's length (duration), the narration track's own length, and whether the picture is cut / the sentences projected.
